name: Sárbogárd (Hungary)
description: Green field charged at the centre with the town arms of Sárbogárd (a crowned purple shield with a white beetle, supported by two yellow lions) above the name SÁRBOGÁRD in black.
history: The town's arms and flag are laid down in the municipal decree of 20 April 1998 on the arms and flag of the town. Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Sárbogárd arms with crown and lion supporters
